name: openscout
description: Your personal agent cloud: a local control plane and mesh network for coding agents

scripts.check: bun run sync-exec:fence && bun run check:core && bun run check:types
scripts.check:types: bun run --cwd packages/protocol check && bun run --cwd packages/agent-sessions check && bun run --cwd packages/runtime check && bun run --cwd packages/session-trace check && bun run --cwd packages/pairing check && bun run --cwd packages/cli check && bun run --cwd packages/mesh-extension check
scripts.test:unit: bun run test:cli && bun run test:unit:source
scripts.test:unit:source: bun run test:remote-target-programs && bun run --cwd packages/protocol test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-sessions test && bun run --cwd packages/runtime test && bun run --cwd packages/pairing test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test:source && bun run --cwd packages/session-trace test && node --test scripts/ship-release.test.mjs scripts/bump-version.test.mjs scripts/production-workflows.test.mjs scripts/bundle-core.test.mjs scripts/check-core-boundary.test.mjs scripts/check-packed-dependencies.test.mjs && bun run --cwd packages/mesh-extension test && bun run test:pairing-capsule
scripts.test:pairing-capsule: bun test --isolate packages/runtime/src/pairing-security/trust-authority-view.test.ts scripts/pairing-trust-owner-process.test.ts scripts/pairing-trust-owner-census.test.ts scripts/pairing-cutover-process.test.ts scripts/pairing-slot-reclamation-process.test.ts scripts/pairing-quiescent-reclamation-process.test.ts scripts/pairing-authority-view-fixtures.test.ts scripts/pairing-v1-closure.test.ts && bun test scripts/pairing-slot-identity.test.ts && bun scripts/pairing-capsule-controls.ts && bun scripts/pairing-slot-identity-controls.ts && bun scripts/pairing-slot-reclamation-controls.ts && bun scripts/pairing-authority-view-controls.ts && bun scripts/pairing-quiescent-reclamation-controls.ts && bun scripts/pairing-cutover-controls.ts && bun run test:pairing-cutover:compiled && node scripts/pairing-authority-view-compiled-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: bun run check && bun run test:scenarios && bun run test:e2e:agents
scripts.cli:build: bun run protocol:build && bun run runtime:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.runtime:build: bun run protocol:build && bun run --cwd packages/runtime build
